Feature: Self-Test Suite for U14_Self_Test

  Scenario Outline: Test accuracy of the O2 sensor
    Given the O2 sensor is initialized
    When the O2 sensor is commanded to a value of <o2_value>
    Then the O2 sensor reading should be within <accuracy_range> of the commanded value

    Examples:
      | o2_value | accuracy_range |
      | 20       | ±1             |
      | 30       | ±2             |
      | 40       | ±3             |
      | 50       | ±4             |
      | 60       | ±5             |

  Scenario Outline: Validate blower response: commanded speed vs. pressure achieved
    Given the blower is initialized
    When the blower is commanded to a speed of <blower_speed>
    Then the pressure achieved should be within <pressure_range> of the expected pressure at that speed

    Examples:
      | blower_speed | pressure_range |
      | 1000         | ±50            |
      | 2000         | ±100           |
      | 3000         | ±150           |
      | 4000         | ±200           |
      | 5000         | ±250           |

  Scenario Outline: Validate pinch valves pressure response at a fixed blower speed
    Given the blower is initialized and set to a speed of <blower_speed>
    When the pinch valves are opened
    Then the pressure at the pinch valves should be within <pressure_range> of the expected pressure at that speed

    Examples:
      | blower_speed | pressure_range |
      | 1000         | ±50            |
      | 2000         | ±100           |
      | 3000         | ±150           |
      | 4000         | ±200           |
      | 5000         | ±250           |

  Scenario Outline: Validate audible alarm devices
    Given the audible alarm devices are initialized
    When the audible alarm devices are activated
    Then the alarm should be audible

    Examples:
      | alarm_device | expected |
      |--------------|----------|
      | Buzzer       | Audible  |
      | Horn         | Audible  |
      | Speaker      | Audible  |

  Scenario Outline: Validate visual alarms
    Given the visual alarms are initialized
    When the visual alarms are activated
    Then the alarm should be visible

    Examples:
      | alarm_device | expected |
      |--------------|----------|
      | LED          | Visible  |
      | LCD Display  | Visible  |
      | Indicator    | Visible  |
